title: Automation and the Question of Shared Gains
text:
Automation is reshaping labour markets faster than most institutions can adapt. Routine tasks in warehouses, offices and transport are increasingly performed by machines, while new roles demand skills that few workers have yet acquired. Economists disagree about whether the net effect will be job loss or simply a painful transition between occupations.

The distribution of these gains is the decisive question. If the productivity created by machines accrues mainly to owners of capital, inequality may widen even as total output rises. Some thinkers therefore propose redistributive measures, such as taxing automated production, so that the benefits of technological change are shared more broadly.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what are machines increasingly performing?
options: Routine tasks in warehouses, offices and transport

questions.text: What does the second paragraph say may widen even as total output rises?
What does the passage imply about the views of economists?
options: They agree that automation will create no new jobs
They are unsure whether automation will mainly cause job loss or a difficult transition
They have never studied labour markets

questions.text: Why might some thinkers propose taxing automated production?
options: To ensure that the benefits of technological change are shared more broadly
To reduce the number of machines in warehouses
To make production more expensive for everyone

vocabulary.definition: the use of machines to carry out tasks previously done by people
the amount of output produced for a given amount of effort or resources
unfair differences in income, opportunity or status between groups
designed to move resources from some groups to others

paragraph_translations: አውቶሜሽን የሥራ ገበያዎችን ከብዙ ተቋማት ማስተካከያ ፍጥነት በላይ እየቀየረ ነው። በመጋዘኖች፣ በቢሮዎችና በትራንስፖርት ውስጥ ያሉ ተደጋጋሚ ሥራዎች በማሽኖች እየተከናወኑ ሲሆን፣ አዲሶቹ ሥራዎች ብዙ ሠራተኞች ገና ያልያዙትን ክህሎት ይጠይቃሉ። ኤኮኖሚስቶች ውጤቱ የሥራ መጥፋት ይሁን ወይስ በሥራ ዓይነቶች መካከል ያለ ከባድ ሽግግር ይሁን በሚለው ላይ አይስማሙም።

የእነዚህ ትርፎች ስርጭት ወሳኙ ጥያቄ ነው። በማሽኖች የሚፈጠረው ምርታማነት በዋናነት ለካፒታል ባለቤቶች የሚደርስ ከሆነ፣ አጠቃላይ ምርት ቢጨምርም እኩል አለመሆን ሊሰፋ ይችላል። ስለዚህ አንዳንድ አሳቢዎች በራስ-ሰር ለሚመረት ምርት ግብር መጣልን የመሰሉ መልሶ የማከፋፈል እርምጃዎችን ያቀርባሉ፤ ይህም የቴክኖሎጂ ለውጥ ጥቅም በሰፊው እንዲካፈል ለማድረግ ነው።
